title: Paused timelines fired at scrub-progress thresholds
summary: Paused copy timelines ride a `top top` → `bottom bottom` linear scrub without being scrubbed: a gate that remembers its side plays one at progress `≥ .3` (`timeScale 1.5`) and reverses it at `≥ .6` or back below `.3` (`3.5`), a final line plays at `≥ .81` (`1.25`); a step label flipped by two `.001 s` tweens at `.5` inside the scrub; refresh snaps each timeline with `progress(0|1)`; fade-only copy and a still bloom under reduced motion, no tween in the static tier
variants: copy window [.3, .6) played at timeScale 1.5, reversed at 3.5; final line from .81 at 1.25 (this, default)
step change inside the scrub with two .001 s tweens at one position (this)
gate a component instead of copy: build it on entering the window, reset and destroy it on leaving
